task.title: Release one exact claimed schedule revision
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/837 by exposing revision-bound recovery from claimed to pending with exact caller rationale.
acceptance_criteria: Validate identity and non-blank release reason before storage access.
Delegate exact lifecycle and revision checks to ScheduleStore::release.
Preserve exact recovery evidence and append nothing on rejected transitions.

attempts.diagnostic: The focused integration test failed because release was an unrecognized subcommand.
attempts.patch: Added focused integration coverage for the required success, absence or conflict, validation, and fail-closed paths.

attempts.summary: Implemented the bounded contract and refactored only demonstrated duplication.
attempts.diagnostic: The capability existed below the requested boundary or required one new typed kernel operation.
attempts.patch: Added a thin release adapter, stable diagnostics, complete JSON serialization, and stale, missing, wrong-state, and storage coverage.

outcome.summary: Callers can explicitly release one claimed revision without inferred worker state, lease expiry, retry, dispatch, or execution.

lessons: Recovery rationale should remain caller-owned exact evidence.
Release authority must not imply worker death, lease expiry, or automatic retry policy.
